audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: Zaahen wins 53.04% over 839 games but the chart gives Aurora four stages and Zaahen none. The mirror (aurora__zaahen) has already been audited and set its chart as an atomic group to Skill / Aurora / Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Aurora / Skill.
audit.why: The two directions must not contradict. Reusing the mirror's chart resolves the packet defect at the same time — Aurora keeps Level 2 and first item, which her range genuinely earns, and Zaahen takes 4-5 and 6 where Across the Veil's 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown leaves her without an exit.
audit.corrected: Rows Level 3, Levels 4-5, Level 6 and 2+ items flipped to match the mirror, as matched full+content pairs; ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's (5/3/5/7/7/3/5). whys[2], whys[3], whys[4] and whys[6] rewritten so the prose no longer argues the opposite of its own badge.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes named no cooldowns, so 'commit when her blink is down' had no duration attached.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s — by far the longest escape in the lane — and The Weirding (15/14/13/12/11s) hops her backward as a second disengage. Between Worlds is 140/120/100s at only 250 range.
audit.corrected: 20s and 13s written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0].text, mid, whys[3] and whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three kit errors. (1) 'W Stellar Sojourn' is fabricated — her W is Across the Veil (spikes[0].text, mid, wants.foe[1]). (2) Her passive is called a 'spirit-explode' that 'adds burst' — Riot's text says exorcised spirits follow her and HEAL her. It is sustain, not damage. (3) Two real interactions were absent: Across the Veil makes her invisible on landing, and The Weirding hops her backward after the blast.
audit.why: A player told her passive bursts will build MR against a heal, and a player told to punish her after the blink will lose her to invisibility. The passive being a heal is exactly what makes Grievous Wounds core — which the missing-interactions file also flags.
audit.corrected: Stellar Sojourn replaced with Across the Veil throughout the fields the band allowed; the passive restated as healing in spikes[1].text, mid and whys[4], with anti-heal named; invisibility and The Weirding's backward hop added to spikes[0].text and breakdown.cooldowns; report[5].t now explains the Twofold Hex recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization tells the player to buy MR and never mentions Grievous Wounds, even though her passive is a heal.
audit.why: Spirit Abjuration heals off every spell and attack she lands, so extended trades are decided by anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named in spikes[1].text and mid.

edits.before: At level 3 she dominates — W blink dodges your E and she wins every poke trade.
edits.after: Level 3 is even — Across the Veil dodges your E, but it is down 20 seconds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay hers as her mobility and range keep you from committing.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn yours — Across the Veil is 20s and you close inside it.

edits.before: At 6 Between Worlds and her passive burst let her zone and out-trade your all-in.
edits.after: At 6 you hold it — Between Worlds zones you, but her passive only heals her.

edits.before: With 2+ items she scales into a high-value mage you can't reach without her blink down.
edits.after: With 2+ items it is even — reach her in the 20s while Across the Veil is spent.

edits.before: Aurora is a ranged AP mage top; her Q Twofold and W Stellar Sojourn blink give her poke and a get-out you can't match early. She kites your E Golden Onslaught with the W dash, so you eat spells trying to walk up and lose the poke war.
edits.after: Aurora is a ranged AP mage top; Twofold Hex pokes and Across the Veil leaps her out and turns her invisible on landing. But it is a 20-second cooldown — walk her down inside it, and remember The Weirding hops her backward too.

edits.before: R Between Worlds zones a whole area and her passive spirit-explode adds burst; she can R to disengage your all-in or trap you in the field. Save your R Final Retribution as a hard-engage answer since she'll blink otherwise.
edits.after: R Between Worlds zones a whole area and lets her teleport across it; her passive only heals her, so bring Grievous Wounds early. Save your R Final Retribution as a hard-engage answer since she'll blink otherwise.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 favour Aurora: she kites your engage with Stellar Sojourn and wins the poke exchange every time you walk up. At 6 stays hers as Between Worlds zones your all-in and her passive adds burst.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 turn: Across the Veil is a 20-second cooldown, so walk her down the moment it is spent. At 6 Between Worlds zones your all-in, but her passive only heals her — bring anti-heal.

edits.before: Aurora's W blink being on cooldown before you engage
edits.after: Across the Veil on cooldown before you step up

edits.before: Using W Stellar Sojourn to dodge your E gap-close
edits.after: Across the Veil dodging your E, then invisible

edits.before: - Aurora Twofold Hex: matchup-defining — Her escape. Burst when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Aurora Across the Veil (20s at rank 3): her leap, and she is invisible on landing. - The Weirding (13s): it hops her backward too. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Aurora's Twofold Hex (Blink): Her escape. Burst when it’s down. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Twofold Hex is a curse she recasts to drag back — the return hit is the one that hurts, so step off the line.

notes: The chart here is reused from the already-audited mirror rather than invented, which also clears the packet's own defect line. Ratings are proposed as the inverse of the mirror's and belong to the same atomic group as the side flips. 'Stellar Sojourn' was a fabricated W name; it survives in no field I could not reach, but the phrase 'Twofold Hex' as the tracked cooldown remains in ~15 full-layer fields where it is the wrong ability to be tracking — Across the Veil is.
